block_target: Remove the explicit 16-slot workspace coordinates from v0.50 and test whether independently parameterized agents learn a compact recurrent joint message that is sufficient, bilaterally writable, causally necessary, planner-bound, and ephemeral.
claim_boundary: The experiment establishes a learned compact recurrent message state without prescribed latent coordinates under round-level task curriculum. The identical terminal-only architecture does not reach the same result under the frozen budget. Therefore fully spontaneous emergence from terminal loss alone remains open.
known_limitations: The positive result depends on round-level curriculum targets.
The identical terminal-only architecture did not discover the full algorithm under the frozen budget.
The recurrent channel, channel dimension, alternation schedule, horizon, and task ontology are engineered.
All eight message dimensions contribute at the 99.9% variance threshold; a minimal four-dimensional code did not emerge.
The task is finite, deterministic, synthetic, and based on affine operators over GF(2)^4.
Linear state readout is high but not perfect, so the message is not simply an exact one-hot state code.
The result does not prove terminal-only emergence is impossible with different optimization or architecture.
The agents are small task-specific neural modules rather than pretrained language models.
No persistent pair autobiography or composite identity remains after message erasure.
Two broad regression commands timed out without summaries and are not claimed as passes or failures.
No subjective-awareness, shared-consciousness, sentience, valence, suffering, desire, or moral-status claim is supported.
next_unclosed_gap: Remove the supplied round-level curriculum: train from terminal joint objectives with variable sequence lengths, asynchronous turn timing, unknown bottleneck dimension, self-generated intermediate consistency, and unseen operator families; then discover and causally ablate any compact recurrent sufficient state only after training.

validation.broad_combined_commands: incomplete_timeout; no pass or failure claimed

what_emerged: The geometry of the eight-dimensional recurrent message.
The representation of the accumulated four-bit joint state.
Agent A and Agent B update rules over that anonymous message.
Both agents' decoders from the learned message.
A causal sufficient state that generalizes to unseen operation compositions.
what_remained_engineered: The existence and eight-dimensional capacity of the recurrent channel.
The A/B alternating update schedule and three-round horizon.
The public initial state and finite operator task ontology.
Round-level curriculum targets for accumulated state.
The training objective family and fixed 1,000-step optimization budget.
